concept.title: Coverage rollup
concept.shortdesc: Every requirement gets a rollup status computed from its verification method and linked test results:

strow.stentry: Method is test and the latest results for all verifying tests pass
At least one verifying test's latest result is a fail
No fails, but a verifying test is blocked
No fails or blocks, but a verifying test has no recorded result yet
A non-test method (inspection, analysis, demonstration) marked verified on the requirement
Method is test but no test case verifies the requirement, or a non-test method not yet marked verified
The requirement has no verification method set

conbody.p: The dashboard shows summary cards and a stacked bar for the distribution, plus a Requirement coverage table listing every requirement with its method and rollup chip.
